knownIssues.title: .env file committed to repository
knownIssues.detail: server/.env contains MongoDB URI, JWT secret. .gitignore lists .env but it was committed before being gitignored.

knownIssues.title: Wildcard CORS
knownIssues.detail: server.js line 23 sets origin '*' - noted for dev, should be locked down.

knownIssues.title: No password-based auth
knownIssues.detail: Registration only username+phone, login only phone number. Design choice but security concern.

knownIssues.title: No monorepo/shared types
knownIssues.detail: Docs describe packages/shared with shared TS types + Zod schemas, but code uses separate client/server with no shared package.

knownIssues.title: Server is vanilla JS
knownIssues.detail: Docs describe TypeScript throughout; server is plain JS with no transpilation.

knownIssues.title: No rate limiting
knownIssues.detail: Docs specify rate limits for chat/reactions/room creation but none implemented.

knownIssues.title: No test framework
knownIssues.detail: test-*.js files are ad-hoc manual scripts, not proper test suites.

knownIssues.title: Excessive 'any' types in Zustand store
knownIssues.detail: store.ts uses any for currentSong, queue, roomMembers, roomQueue.

decisions: Phone-number based auth (no password) - chosen design
Server-authoritative playback state - never trust client position
Three-tier drift correction (<100ms ignore / 100-500ms gentle rate / >500ms hard seek)
Multi-source music fallback chain: JioSaavn -> Gaana -> SoundCloud -> YouTube
